name: Dana
slug: Dana is a thoughtful half-elf cleric and Gatekeeper of the Pitel keystone, connected to the Great Eldarin Tree alongside Gerk.
description: Dana is a half-elf cleric and one of the most knowledgeable members of the group. She is thoughtful and perceptive, often connecting current events to previously known lore or objectives. She believes Gerk’s role has a divine purpose and is willing to support his responsibilities, becoming connected to the Great Eldarin Tree alongside him. Dana is the Gatekeeper of the Pitel keystone, which is associated with the center of the rings of Atlas and aligns with a place she had previously sought to reach.

log.summary: Dana chose to follow Gerk, believing his selection of the Midgard keystone had a divine purpose, and became involved in his new responsibility while gaining a connection to the Great Eldarin Tree. She accepted the Pitel keystone and became its Gatekeeper; Pitel is the center of the rings of Atlas, a place Dana had previously sought a way to reach. During the events surrounding Gerk's portals, Dana recognized Daisy's white flowers as evidence of her presence, received guidance from Emhet to hold her breath and avoid yelling during a mind walk, and advised Gerk to concentrate on familiar locations to improve his control over portal destinations. She also identified the forest reached through one of Gerk's portals as being near Langdale and urged the party not to rush through the unstable portal until other matters had been addressed.

log.summary: Dana confirmed that several crew members, including Garrett, Abel, and Fritz, had previously died and were revived through her efforts to keep them alive. She investigated the ruined site's gatehouse and archives, but concluded that too little usable material remained to provide much additional research, though she intends to consult Plymouth Gawater about the gatehouse and its history. During the doorway event, Dana was visibly concerned and flabbergasted by the reality distortion, noting that the party did not understand the mechanism and that she could not reasonably have supervised Gerk's actions. She prepared to use Feather Fall if needed, then experienced a magical surge reminiscent of being near deities, recognizing that spellcasting had been greatly enhanced and that her spent spell slots may have been restored. Separated from the others, she recognized similarities to the party's previous experience in La-rel. Dana retained her serpentine bracers and used a summoned constrictor snake as a visible positional marker while moving.
